title: Could prime Messi beat Real Madrid on his own?
caption: Could prime Messi beat Real Madrid on his own? 11 v 1 at the Bernabéu. ⚽🐐 #could #messi #realmadrid #elclasico #barcelona #football #shorts #fyp

scenes.text: Could prime Messi beat Real Madrid on his own?
The Bernabéu. {{fans}}Eighty thousand Madrid fans. {{eleven}}Real Madrid: eleven players. {{messi}}Messi: one. {{nomates}}No team-mates. {{nokeeper}}No goalkeeper.
Kick-off. {{press}}Real press with all eleven. {{none}}Messi has no one to pass to. {{self}}So he passes to the only player who is always free: {{himself}}himself. {{through}}He's through.
Saved. {{counter}}And while he is up front, {{empty}}nobody is in his goal. {{fifty}}Real score from fifty metres. ||0.2|| {{nil}}Nil, one.
So Messi stops passing. {{half}}He takes the ball on halfway. {{past}}Past ten outfield players. {{keeper}}Past the keeper. ||0.3|| {{one}}One, one.

But one man has to cover the whole pitch. {{stam}}His stamina drops. {{walk}}So he does what prime Messi always did. {{walks}}He walks. {{bored}}Real stop marking a walking man. {{sprint}}One sprint. {{foul}}Foul. {{fk}}Free kick. ||0.3|| {{top}}Top corner. {{onetwo}}One, two.

Minute eighty nine. {{subs}}Real bring on three fresh substitutes. {{bench}}Messi has no bench. {{corner}}Corner. {{box}}Real send everyone into the box. {{mark}}Messi can mark exactly one of them. ||0.3|| {{two}}Two, two.

Minute ninety two. {{three}}Stamina: three percent. {{walked}}But he walked all game. {{saved}}He saved exactly one sprint. {{last}}One defender left. {{self}}Pass to himself. ||0.5|| {{goal}}Two, three.
He shows his shirt to the Bernabéu. ||0.3|| {{y17}}He did exactly that in {2017|twenty seventeen}. {{same}}Same score.
